title: Field Notes
description: A short guide to keeping useful farm records. Original lessons packaged for offline use.

lessons.title: A record you can return to
lessons.body: Write the date, the field and what you did. Include quantities and their units when you know them. Keep observations separate from guesses. A photo can help you compare the same place later.

lessons.title: Keep measurements clear
lessons.body: Name each field consistently. Save the boundary and check GPS accuracy. A farm boundary can include paths, buildings and uncultivated land, so its area need not equal the sum of planted fields. Correct uncertain points before relying on an estimate.

quiz.question: Which record is easier to compare later?
answers: North field, 12 September, 8 kg of seed
